annotation.title_clean: 国务院办公厅函〔2026〕14号：养老机构安全风险隐患排查整治工作通知
annotation.title_en: General Office of the State Council Letter [2026] No. 14: Notice on Investigating and Rectifying Safety Risks in Elderly Care Institutions
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院办公厅 (General Office of the State Council, China)
annotation.summary_en: Chinese State Council General Office notice on investigating and rectifying safety risks in elderly care institutions, setting targets through 2028. It requires joint multi-agency inspections, emergency plans and drills, evacuation facilities, closed-loop management and accountability tracing. It contains no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Eliminate existing safety hazards in elderly care institutions by end-2026, with longer-term mechanisms by 2028
Joint multi-department inspections via a single checklist, at least once a year per county
Institutions must have emergency plans, evacuation facilities and drills at least every six months
Closed-loop 'inspect-rectify-assess-close' management and accountability tracing for accidents
